text: If teens can't use the app, ¿why asking the age after logging in? ¿Why in te play store says that is for teenagers?
author: Wendy Yazmín Sotelo Valle
developer_reply: Thanks for calling this out—it’s a great question. We ask for age to ensure safety and show the right info based on who’s using the app. Right now, Shimmer is designed for adults, but we're exploring ways to better support teens too. If you have more questions, feel free to reach us at support@shimmer.care 💛
